{{Top|leg}}
An '''electric defense grid''' was a self-defense device installed on some [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droids]] to make up for their weaknesses in melee combat. It was either installed as part of the droid's [[Armor/Legends|armor]], or overlaid on the outer shell.

If a combatant made contact with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] when the grid was active, they received an electrical shock. This only happened if the combatant made direct contact or used a conductive weapon. [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsabers]] and other non-conductive weapons were immune to this effect.
